letter.subject: EU261 compensation claim - flight AF652 on 2026-09-30
letter.body:
Dear Air France Customer Relations,

We act on behalf of our client regarding flight AF652 on 2026-09-30 from Paris (CDG) to Saint-Denis (Réunion) (RUN), which was delayed, arriving 5 hours and 0 minutes late.

Under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Articles 5, 7 and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU, the passenger is entitled to compensation of EUR 400 for this long delay. The flight distance is 9,369 km.

Based on the information available to us, no extraordinary circumstances apply.

Please pay EUR 400 within 14 days of this letter and send your reply to our claims team.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Team
